criteria.description: Tapping the primary 'New session' button creates a session immediately WITHOUT opening a dialog, in the selected project's cwd ($HOME fallback), and selects it (real-surface widget test on _SessionListHeader)
Server bridge handles SDK session.updated: maps info.title -> the Rhythm session name, persists it, and broadcasts SessionUpdatedMessage (vitest spy + real Session shape)
A SessionUpdatedMessage carrying a title replaces the 'New session' placeholder in the list/header (flutter test)
An empty session name renders as 'New session' (placeholder); createSession accepts an empty name server- and client-side
A secondary '...' (options) control next to 'New session' opens the existing _NewSessionDialog (cwd/branch/task/name) unchanged
ai-workflow checks --level pr exit 0; vitest + flutter test green
